subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should OpenClaw keep bootstrap prompt files workspace-owned and warn on bootstrap-named files in agentDir, or should explicitly configured agentDir become an additional trusted bootstrap prompt source?
rationale: Current source and docs make the workspace the bootstrap prompt source, while user reports show real silent-misconfiguration risk; loading agentDir files would change where security-sensitive model instructions are trusted from.

options.title: Land warning-only diagnostic
options.body: Preserve the current workspace prompt-source contract, warn when bootstrap-named files are found in agentDir, and update docs or doctor guidance for self-serve correction.

options.title: Adopt explicit agentDir loading
options.body: Treat explicitly configured agentDir as a trusted per-agent bootstrap source after defining merge precedence, caller coverage, and security review expectations.

options.title: Pause pending design
options.body: Keep the issue and linked pull requests open until maintainers decide the permanent prompt-source boundary.

recommendation.title: Land warning-only diagnostic
recommendation.body: Preserve the current workspace prompt-source contract, warn when bootstrap-named files are found in agentDir, and update docs or doctor guidance for self-serve correction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across bootstrap resolver, workspace docs, and boundary-sensitive runtime changes.
